changelog: The Sacred Wood's deer is a proper quarry now. Shells, fire, storms and anything that isn't one of your own soldiers pass straight THROUGH it — a hunt you win by dropping ordnance across the map isn't a hunt, so you have to actually run it down. And it can finally get away: it slips through a picket line instead of being stopped dead by it, terrain neither slows nor shelters it, and it breaks for open ground rather than backing itself into the map edge. Previously it spent 71% of a hunt inside someone's reach and was frequently stuck with nowhere to go at all; now it's 2%.
